Feeling light, dizzy, and stumblimg around are just a few of the begining side effects. Later comes dissorinantation, hallunizations, and paranoia. We finally made it to the campsite hours later after driving around in circles. We got out set up camp and stumbled around in total bliss and confussion. At one point i was crawling around and came to a speed bump feaking out i called my friend over to help. He gave me his hand and helped me over this tedious obstacle. We had no clue what was going on and couldn't quite figure out where we were or what was going on.
After many hours we found our campsite and crashed. THe next morning or afternoon i should say we came to. We were totally blizted, in a daze all day. We drove 40 miles to get supplies and came back and took another box. By the time we started to fell the surge we realized we needed ice for our beers and wood for the fire. It took us three hours to finally get up and drive to the store and only to come back with two bags of ice, a six pack, and no wood. The lady at the store thought we were nuts. And we thought she was crazy.
We somehow made it back to the site and waited for nightfall. Little did we know what a night this would be! Night soon came and so did the trips. We were just all sitting around the fire drinking and talking when one of my buddies came out and told us he was Satan. We just sort of looked at him,and thats when it happened he grew horns and a tail. We totally freaked but couldn't move. He began to stir the fire with his walking stick which looked like a pitch fork to us and it got bigger and bigger, and hotter. I was shaking so bad and my friend just stared straight ahead with his eyes bugging out. Our third friend(whose birthday it was) who had been drinking all day also suddenly began to puke and piss all over himself and then collapsed in a pile and began to swin around in the dirt and puke. He moaned from time to time.
We were so fucked up we couldn't help him, plus we were scared of Satan. We thought he died. All of a sudden there was a loud noise and lights came and the forest split apart like a movie set. Satan said that they were just changing scenes. Then the sky lit up and we witnessed a awsome light show. We were possitive that the Merry Melodies tune was going to start up and we were going to see cartoons. After that i was convinced we were in hell and had died. Satan told us to get into the tent because the sherieff was coming around(apparently there had been some fight) we walked to what i thought was a herse and got in. I then started to trip really bad then and thought we got buried to looked up and could see my grave and everything.
Hours later I climbed out of the Tent to find my two other friends back to normal not dead or Satan anymore talking and laughing. I went to bed soon after that. But when I woke in the morning to a heany downpour, i was convinced that One of my friends had died, one had turnred into Satan, and that two of us had gone to hell. Not to mention that we were in the middle of some kind of Trumman Show. It was probaly the best trip we had ever had. We will continue to go to C-World on a daily basis. Coricidin is the best!
